# Checkup Lite support

> Support and privacy pages for Checkup Lite, a Mac App Store app that shows where disk space went on your Mac, keeps a free-space target and clears caches safely. Published by MoleCare LTD.

## Pages

- [Support and common questions](https://yauhenbichel.github.io/checkup-support/): how to get help, what the app can remove, what Preview mode is, where the logs are
- [Privacy policy](https://yauhenbichel.github.io/checkup-support/privacy.html): what data the app reads and what leaves your Mac

## Report a problem

- [GitHub issues](https://github.com/YauhenBichel/checkup-support/issues)
